title: IPB110N20N3LF OptiMOS 3 Linear FET, 200 V, Final Data Sheet Rev. 2.1, 2017-02-16
method: Table values copied from the datasheet text with a fetch tool (no curve digitized). Distributor-hosted (Farnell) copy of the Infineon PDF. V_DSS = 200 V from Table 1 / V(BR)DSS min (V_GS = 0 V, I_D = 1 mA). R_DS(on) 11 mOhm max (9.8 typ) at V_GS = 10 V, I_D = 88 A. R_thJC 0.5 K/W max (0.3 typ). The only numeric linear-mode figure is the Table 1 key parameter 'I_pulse (V_DS = 56 V, t_p = 10 ms) 8.7 A'; no T_C is printed in that row (Diagram 3 SOA is labelled T_C = 25 C, D = 0, so 25 C is likely but not stated for this row). The SOA (Diagram 3) and Z_thJC (Diagram 4) are graph-only and were not read. Other ratings: I_D,pulse 352 A; E_AS 560 mJ; R_thJA 40 K/W on 6 cm2.
